glossary.definition:
As used in this division, "good faith" has the same meaning as in section 1301.201 of the Revised Code.

(B) A bank may, with the customer's consent, provide electronically any statement, notice, or report required to be provided customers under this chapter. A customer's consent may be obtained electronically or in writing.

(C) A bank customer may, with the bank's consent, provide electronically any notice required to be provided to the bank under this chapter. A bank's consent may be obtained electronically or in writing.
